gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund column: p5 Rescue Fund column prints 'Transfers from (to) other funds' 12,578 (the statement's transfers_in 12,578); not in detail -> added below. (2) Different basis: detail holds the intra-General-Fund departmental transfers from the Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (pp13-14 row 'Transfers from (to) other funds': Pool 29,605 + Youth 1,500 in = 31,105; Fire (5,000) + Sales Tax (38,683) out = 43,683; departmental Total column (12,578) = the General Fund's p5 transfer to the Rescue Fund). These are transfers between departments of one fund, printed gross on the departmental schedule; the fund statement shows only the fund net. Arithmetic: 31,105 + 12,578 (added) = 43,683 vs statement 12,578; the remaining -31,105 is exactly the departmental gross-up (Pool 29,605 + Youth 1,500), not an error.
